title: Naturality of Ext classes for morphisms of short exact sequences
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] equipped with Ext groups as in [def-sc-ext-sheaf]. Let $S_1:0\to A_1\to B_1\to C_1\to0$ and $S_2:0\to A_2\to B_2\to C_2\to0$ be short exact sequences with extension classes $[S_i]\in\operatorname{Ext}^1(C_i,A_i)$, and let $f:S_1\to S_2$ be a morphism of short exact sequences with end maps $f_1:A_1\to A_2$ and $f_3:C_1\to C_2$. Then, writing $\circ$ for Yoneda composition in the usual order (right factor applied first) and $f_1[1]$, $f_3$ for the classes of $f_1$, $f_3$ in degree $0$, one has $f_1[1]\circ[S_1]=[S_2]\circ f_3$ in $\operatorname{Ext}^1(C_1,A_2)$.
